say:2:1221603001:1.text: Seriously, you newbies are unbelievable! Slacking off really comes naturally to you guys, huh?
say:2:1221603001:1.source_cn: 唉，你们这几个新来的真没眼色！别的不学，偷懒倒是无师自通！

say:3:1221603002:1.text: Newbies? Slack off? What are you talking about, Sir?
say:3:1221603002:1.source_cn: 新来的？偷懒？大叔，你在说什么啊？

say:4:1221603003:1.text: Still playing dumb? Don't think you can get away with being lazy because you look cute... Ugh, how on earth did I end up with these hopeless new recruits?
say:4:1221603003:1.source_cn: 还装傻？别以为你长得可爱就可以少干活……唉，怎么又招了...

say:5:1221603004:1.text: There are only a few of us in this entire workshop, so don't even think about slacking off.
say:5:1221603004:1.source_cn: 整个百炼工坊里搞勤务的就咱们几个人，你可别想混日子。

choice_prompt:6:1221603004.text: There are only a few of us in this entire workshop, so don't even think about slacking off.
choice_prompt:6:1221603004.source_cn: 整个百炼工坊里搞勤务的就咱们几个人，你可别想混日子。

say:7:1221603005:1.text: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.
say:7:1221603005:1.source_cn: 不是勤务工是什么，难道你还能是当家的请来的贵客？
say:7:1221603005:1.male: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.
say:7:1221603005:1.female: If you don't work here, who are you? Some important guests of Sonja? Just knock it off already.

say:8:1221603007:1.text: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!
say:8:1221603007:1.source_cn: 你们别听其他人说什么能偷懒就偷懒，能少干就少干的，那都...
say:8:1221603007:1.male: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!
say:8:1221603007:1.female: Don't listen to them telling you to do as little work as possible! That's all nonsense!

say:10:1221603009:1.text: No more buts! I have no time for your excuses! If you keep on loafing around, you'll get me in trouble too!
say:10:1221603009:1.source_cn: 别可是了，什么借口我都不听。再继续偷懒，别说你们了，连...

say:11:1221603010:1.text: Just look around! There's a pile of junk waiting to be sorted, weapons that need to be polished, and plenty of chores in the kitchen waiting to be done!
say:11:1221603010:1.source_cn: 你看看，一大堆的杂物没整理，武器没保养，厨房还等着我们帮忙！

say:12:1221603011:1.text: Now, come with me to <style="highlight">sort out the junk</style> first. Move it! Quick!
say:12:1221603011:1.source_cn: 你们先跟我去<style=highlight>整理杂物...

say:14:1221603006:1.text: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?
say:14:1221603006:1.source_cn: 这里就你们几个新人，我怎么会认错！
say:14:1221603006:1.male: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?
say:14:1221603006:1.female: You're the only new guys here! How could I be mistaken?

choice:6:1:2.text: You're mistaking us for somebody else.
choice:6:1:2.male: You're mistaking us for somebody else.
choice:6:1:2.female: You're mistaking us for somebody else.
